newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Zaire threatens war on Rwanda, Burundi.
newsitem.headline: Zaire threatens war on Rwanda, Burundi.

text.p: A Zairean envoy said on Friday his country was ready for war with neighbouring Burundi and Rwanda to defend its territory.

The international community should be ashamed of its role as "a passive accomplice" for not denouncing violation of Zaire's territory by Rwanda and Burundi, deputy foreign minister Lokondo Yoka, who is on an explanatory mission around Europe and North Africa, told a news conference in Brussels.
"Uvira, Goma and Bukavu (towns in eastern Zaire) have been occupied by Burundian and Rwandan forces for almost two weeks," he said.

He said Rwandan and Burundian refugees, who he said included the Banyamulenge Tutsis, had abused Zaire's hospitality. "We are victims of our own hospitality," he said, but "We are determined to wage a total war... We have the means."

He said the world's media had been misled by the Tutsi government in Kigali about who the real aggressors were in the conflict, which has scattered an estimated 1.2 million mostly Hutu Rwandan and Burundian refugees from camps in eastern Zaire.
An international intervention force would only be tolerated on Zairean soil as long as it did not offer protection to Rwandans or Burundians, Lokondo Yoka said.
"The force must be neutral...it must not hinder Zaire from protecting its territory and defending its independence. If the mandate goes beyond humanitarian aid, we will formally protest."
